data.narrative:
Tomorrow.io is a Series E space & aerospace technology company that has raised $385M+ to date. The valuation universe comprises 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private comparables including SpaceX and Sierra Space, though no private peers operate at sufficient scale or stage proximity to support reliable peer-median benchmarking.

Of three potential valuation methods, only stage-progression analysis is defensible given available data. Applying a 1.4x step-up multiplier—typical for progression from Series E to later institutional rounds—to the $385M total raised proxy yields $539M. A sensitivity band around this estimate, incorporating modest upside and downside variance, produces a range of $458M to $620M. The public Space & Aerospace peer set carries a median P/S multiple of 23.9x across six traded companies, but without disclosed revenue figures for Tomorrow.io, this anchor cannot be operationalized. Peer-median triangulation also fails due to insufficient datapoints in the narrow same-stage/adjacent-stage/similar-tier filters.

The analysis supports a median valuation near $539M, with a reasonable confidence interval spanning $458M–$620M. Key uncertainties include Tomorrow.io's actual revenue run rate (required to anchor public comparables), customer concentration, and cash burn trajectory relative to deployed capital. The single-method reliance also warrants caution; additional revenue or margin disclosure would enable P/S or EV/EBITDA cross-checks.
